behavior: AC1. converge activates lanes from the committed marker, idempotently; a working-tree marker activates nothing
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/lane/ ./internal/converge/ -run 'Activate|Lanes' -v -count=1 | awk '/^--- FAIL|^FAIL/{f=1} /^--- PASS/{p=1} END{exit !(p && !f)}'
